definition_zh: 管理；经营；（企业的）管理层；对疾病或局面的处理方式
definition_en: the activity of running and controlling an organization or process, or the people who do it
core_image: 一只手把散在各处的线头收拢，编成一股能拉动的缰绳
scene: 四家分店各做各的账，月底总对不上数，后来同一个人统一排班、定采购、查库存。Careful management brought the four branches onto one schedule.
sceneCN: 这里 management 指把分散的人、钱与流程收在一起加以调度（第 1 个义项：对组织的统筹经营）；句意：细致的管理让四家分店归到同一张时间表上。图中可辨识物件：账本、排班表、货箱、统一的门牌；对应第 1 个义项。

pos.zh: 管理；经营；管理层；（对疾病、局面的）处理方式

forms.label: 复数（指多家机构的管理层）

senses.title: Running an organization
senses.titleCN: 把一个组织的各项工作统筹起来
senses.definition: the activity of planning, organizing and controlling the work of an organization so that it runs well
senses.definitionCN: 对一个组织的各项工作加以计划、组织与控制，使其运转良好
senses.example: Good management kept the shipyard busy through the downturn.
senses.exampleCN: 良好的管理让这家船厂在衰退期仍有活干。
senses.why: The word began as handling a horse with the hand, and running a firm is that same gesture applied to people, money and schedules.
senses.whyCN: 这个词最初指用手摆弄、驯服一匹马；经营一家公司，就是把同样的动作施加到人、钱与日程上。

senses.title: The people in charge
senses.definition: the group of senior people who make the main decisions in an organization
senses.definitionCN: 在一个组织里作出主要决策的高层群体
senses.example: Management agreed to freeze hiring until spring.
senses.exampleCN: 管理层同意把招聘冻结到春天。
senses.why: Once the activity became a permanent job, the people who did it could be spoken of as one body.
senses.whyCN: 当这种活计变成常设职位，做这件事的人就被当作一个整体来说。

senses.title: Skill in handling people
senses.definition: the ability to deal with people and awkward situations without letting them get out of hand
senses.definitionCN: 与人以及棘手局面打交道时不让事情失控的能力
senses.example: It took patient management to keep the two departments speaking.
senses.exampleCN: 要让两个部门继续对话，需要很有耐心的周旋。
senses.why: A rider controls a horse by feel rather than force, and the same word covers handling people by feel.
senses.whyCN: 骑手靠手感而不是蛮力控制马匹，这个词也用来指靠分寸感与人相处。

senses.title: Careful use of resources
senses.titleCN: 对钱财与时间的节制使用
senses.definition: the careful control of money, time or supplies so that nothing is wasted
senses.definitionCN: 对金钱、时间或物资的谨慎支配，使什么也不被浪费
senses.example: Tighter management of the fuel budget halved the depot's winter costs.
senses.exampleCN: 对燃料预算更严格的把控让仓库的冬季开支减半。
senses.why: What the hand holds it can also ration; the horse-training word grew into the sense of not letting a supply run out.
senses.whyCN: 手握得住东西，也就能分配它；驯马那个词由此长出「不让储备用尽」的意思。

senses.title: Medical care over time
senses.titleCN: 对慢性病的长期治疗与监控
senses.definition: the treatment and steady control of a disease or condition, especially one that lasts
senses.definitionCN: 对疾病或身体状况进行治疗与持续控制，尤指长期存在的情况
senses.example: Pain management now includes a weekly check with a nurse.
senses.exampleCN: 疼痛管理现在包含每周由护士做的一次复查。
senses.why: A doctor who keeps a disease in hand for months is managing it in the same old sense of handling.
senses.whyCN: 医生把一种病在手里管上几个月，用的仍是「用手把控」那个老意思。

senses.title: Control of land and animals
senses.titleCN: 对土地、畜群等自然资源的经营
senses.definition: the control and use of land, animals or natural resources according to a plan
senses.definitionCN: 按计划对土地、牲畜或自然资源加以控制与使用
senses.example: The ranch's grazing management keeps the grass from wearing out.
senses.exampleCN: 牧场的放牧管理让草场不至于被耗尽。
senses.why: Herds and fields were the first things a hand had to manage, so land and livestock keep the oldest layer of meaning.
senses.whyCN: 畜群与田地是手最早要照管的对象，因此土地与牲畜保留了最古老的那层意思。

senses.title: Management as a subject
senses.titleCN: 作为一门学科的管理学
senses.definition: the study of how organizations are run, taught as an academic subject
senses.definitionCN: 研究组织如何运转的学问，作为一门学科来教授
senses.example: He added a management course to his engineering degree.
senses.exampleCN: 他在工程学位之外又加了一门管理课程。
senses.why: In the twentieth century the handling of firms was written down, taught and examined, and so became a discipline.
senses.whyCN: 到了二十世纪，经营企业的门道被写成教材、被教授、被考试，于是成了一门学问。

senses.title: The handling of an event
senses.titleCN: 对某一具体事件或局面的处置
senses.definition: the way a particular problem, crisis or event is dealt with
senses.definitionCN: 对某个具体问题、危机或事件的应对方式
senses.example: The management of the flood response drew criticism from residents.
senses.exampleCN: 洪水应对的处置方式招来了居民的批评。
senses.why: Here the object of handling shrinks from a whole firm to one event, but the gesture itself stays the same.
senses.whyCN: 这里被把控的对象从整个公司缩小到一桩事件，动作本身没有变。

intro.en: Management is the noun of manage, which came through Italian from Latin manus 'hand'. The modern business sense grew out of handling horses, then households, then firms.
intro.cn: management 是 manage 的名词，而 manage 经意大利语上溯到拉丁 manus「手」；现代企业义由驯马、理家一路扩展到经营公司。

items.en: Manus meant 'hand' and also the power to hold something under control, so handling and controlling were one idea from the start.
items.cn: manus 意为「手」，也指把某物握在控制之下的权力，因此「用手摆弄」与「掌控」从一开始就是一个念头。

items.en: Italian maneggiare, built on mano 'hand', meant to handle an object and especially to train a horse; the horse sense is the one usually cited for the English verb.
items.cn: 意大利语 maneggiare 由 mano「手」构成，指用手操作物件，尤指驯马；英语动词最常被追溯到的是驯马这一义。

items.en: Manage entered English in the sixteenth century, first of handling horses and weapons; management, the noun of the activity, followed in the same period.
items.cn: manage 在十六世纪进入英语，最初用于摆弄马匹与兵器；指这项活动的名词 management 也在同一时期出现。

items.en: French ménager 'to run a household' is generally thought to have strengthened the sense of ordering a household or estate, which later widened to a business.
items.cn: 一般认为法语 ménager「料理家务」强化了「安排家务与产业」这一义，后来再扩大到经营企业。

items.en: The noun suffix -ment, from Latin -mentum through French, names the activity or its result, which is how management came to mean both the doing and the body that does it.
items.cn: 这个名词后缀经法语来自拉丁语中表示动作或结果的后缀，management 因此既指「做这件事」，也指「做这件事的那群人」。

items.en: The first recorded dates for the business and academic senses are approximate; the word itself is well attested from the sixteenth century.
items.cn: 企业义与学科义的最早记录年代为约数；这个词本身在十六世纪已有充分记录。

note.en: The first group looks or sounds like management; the second group names neighbouring ways of running something.
note.cn: 第一组在形音上与 management 相近；第二组是意思相邻的其他「经营、支配」说法。

entries.definition: The verb behind the noun; it keeps the plain action of handling a firm or a horse.
entries.definitionCN: 名词背后的动词，保留「摆弄、经营一家公司或一匹马」的直白动作。

entries.definition: The person who performs the activity, formed with the agent suffix; it is not the activity itself.
entries.definitionCN: 做这件事的人，由施动后缀构成，不是这项活动本身。

entries.definition: The adjective describing anything connected with managers or their methods.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，描述与管理者或管理方法有关的事物。

entries.definition: A riding school, from the same Italian word for handling horses; the link is the stable, not the office.
entries.definitionCN: 指马术学校，同出那个表示驯马的意大利词；联系在马厩，而不在办公室。

entries.definition: From Latin manica 'sleeve, handcuff', also built on manus, but it names a restraint rather than a skill.
entries.definitionCN: 来自拉丁 manica「袖子、手铐」，同样由 manus 构成，但指束缚之物，不是经营的本事。

entries.definition: The running of an institution according to its rules; it stresses procedure more than direction.
entries.definitionCN: 按规章维持机构运转，强调程序多过掌舵。

entries.definition: The system by which an organization is directed and held accountable, rather than the daily work of running it.
entries.definitionCN: 指组织被引导并接受问责的制度，而非日常经营的具体事务。

entries.definition: Careful, responsible handling of money or resources left in one's charge.
entries.definitionCN: 对受托的钱财资源做审慎负责的照管。

entries.definition: Authority to direct something; it names the power, while management names the whole activity.
entries.definitionCN: 支配某事的权力；它指权力本身，management 指整套活动。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations use the real Latin root, the real word family and real fixed phrases.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想使用真实的拉丁词根、真实的同族词与真实的固定搭配。

normal.en: Manus is Latin for hand, so management is literally handling.
normal.cn: manus 是拉丁语「手」，management 字面上就是「用手摆弄、照管」。

normal.en: The family runs manage, manager, managerial, manageable and mismanagement.
normal.cn: 同族词有 manage、manager、managerial、manageable 与 mismanagement。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark the everyday sense: time management, crisis management, top management.
normal.cn: 固定说法标出日常义：时间管理、危机处理、高层管理层。

normal.en: The noun suffix -ment turns the act of managing into the thing called management.
normal.cn: 名词后缀把「管理」这个动作变成名为 management 的事物。

normal.en: Italian maneggiare first meant to train a horse by hand, which is the oldest picture in the word.
normal.cn: 意大利语 maneggiare 最初指用手驯马，这是这个词里最古老的画面。

abstract.en: Picture a hand closing on four loose threads at once and pulling them into one line.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手一次攥住四根散线，把它们拉成一条直线。

abstract.en: Picture a rider who never pulls hard, only shifts weight, and the whole herd follows.
abstract.cn: 想象一位从不猛拉缰绳、只挪动重心的骑手，整群马都跟着走。

abstract.en: Picture a desk where every paper is already filed before anyone asks for it.
abstract.cn: 想象一张桌子，别人还没开口要，每份纸就已经归好了位。

examples.en: Local clinics improved their management of patient records last year.
examples.cn: 本地诊所去年改善了对病人档案的管理。

examples.en: The management of the harbour was split between two agencies.
examples.cn: 港口的经营权被分给了两个机构。

examples.en: She studied management after six years on the factory floor.
examples.cn: 在车间干了六年后，她去攻读管理学。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「man（人）+ age（年纪）+ ment（名词）」——管人管到上年纪，就是管理

root: 拉丁 manus「手」→ 意大利 maneggiare「用手操作、驯马」→ 法语 ménager「料理家务」→ 英语 manage「管理」；末尾是名词后缀。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one hand: it runs a firm, becomes a body of managers, handles people, rations supplies, holds a disease in check, works land and herds, turns into a taught subject, and finally grips a single event.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项围绕同一只手：经营一家公司、聚成一群管理者、应对人、分配物资、把病管住、照料土地与畜群、变成一门被教授的学问，最后攥住一桩具体事件。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: one hand gathers loose threads and pulls them into a single rein.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只手把散开的线头收拢，拉成一根缰绳。

branches.en: THE HAND ITSELF: planning, organizing and controlling a whole firm is the original gesture at full size.
branches.cn: 手本身：对一个公司作计划、组织与控制，就是最初那个动作放到最大。

branches.en: WHO HOLDS THE REIN: the handlers become a standing body, and their feel for people becomes a skill.
branches.cn: 谁握着缰绳：做事的人聚成常设群体，他们待人的手感变成一种本事。

branches.en: WHAT IS RATIONED: the hand decides how much fuel, time or money may leave the store.
branches.cn: 被分配的东西：手决定有多少燃料、时间或钱可以从库里出去。

branches.en: CARE OVER TIME: a disease and a pasture are both kept in condition by regular attention.
branches.cn: 长期的照料：疾病与牧场都靠按时看顾才维持在可用状态。

branches.en: FROM PRACTICE TO OBJECT: the habit is written down as a subject, or narrowed to one event.
branches.cn: 从做法变成对象：这套习惯被写成学科，或被收窄到一桩事件上。

intro.en: Management is built from a Latin hand and a noun suffix, and the hand also supports several English words.
intro.cn: management 由一个拉丁语「手」和一个名词后缀构成，这个「手」还支撑起若干英语词。

latinIntro.en: Latin manus gives manual, manacle and mandate; the Italian verb maneggiare gives manage and its English family.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 manus 衍生 manual（手册）、manacle（手铐）与 mandate（委托）；意大利语 maneggiare 衍生 manage 及其英语词族。

items.example: The root supplies the picture of a hand on a rein.
items.exampleCN: 这个词根提供「手握缰绳」的画面。

items.meaning: to handle; to train a horse
items.example: The stable sense is the oldest source of the English word.
items.exampleCN: 马厩里的这一义是英语词最早的来源。

items.example: One hand can manage a horse, a household or a firm.
items.exampleCN: 一只手可以管马、理家，也可以管公司。

items.meaning: the activity of running; the managers
items.example: The suffix turns the deed into the thing named.
items.exampleCN: 后缀把动作变成被命名的事物。

items.meaning: the person who runs the work
items.example: The agent suffix names the hand that holds the rein.
items.exampleCN: 施动后缀点出握缰的那只手。

items.example: The adjective describes the hand's work, not the hand.
items.exampleCN: 形容词描述手的活儿，而不是手本身。

items.example: What can be held in one hand is manageable.
items.exampleCN: 一只手握得住的东西就是可控的。

items.example: The prefix says the hand gripped the rein the wrong way.
items.exampleCN: 前缀说明这只手握错了缰绳。

items.meaningCN: 表示动作或结果的名词后缀
items.example: It is the same ending as in agreement and movement.
items.exampleCN: 它与「同意」「移动」两个词用的是同一个词尾。

latinEntries.meaning: to put into someone's hand; entrust

definition_zh: 经理；管理者；球队或乐队的事务负责人；某项事务的专责人
definition_en: a person whose job is to organize and control the work of a business, team or activity
core_image: 缰绳从一只手伸向前方，前后都是一队等着被安排的人
scene: 演出前一天设备出了故障，那个人逐个打电话借音箱、改场地、重排时间。A manager solves problems before the audience notices.
sceneCN: 这里 manager 指为一项活动统筹人、事与资源的人（第 1 个义项：负责机构或团队运转的人）；句意：一位经理在观众察觉之前就把问题解决掉。图中可辨识物件：音箱、改期通知、场地平面图、装设备的木箱；对应第 1 个义项。

pos.zh: 经理；管理者；事务负责人

senses.title: The person who runs a business
senses.titleCN: 掌管一家企业或团队的人
senses.definition: a person employed to run a business, a team or a group of workers
senses.definitionCN: 受雇掌管一家企业、一支团队或一群工人的人
senses.example: The manager of the repair shop orders parts and sets the rota.
senses.exampleCN: 修理店的经理负责订零件、排班表。
senses.why: Manager is the noun of the hand that holds the rein, so it names whoever keeps the whole body of work moving.
senses.whyCN: manager 是握缰那只手的名词形式，指让全部工作继续转动的那个人。

senses.title: Head of one department
senses.definition: the person who heads a single department or function within a larger organization
senses.definitionCN: 在较大机构中主管某一个部门或职能的人
senses.example: The sales manager reports to the regional director.
senses.exampleCN: 销售经理向区域总监汇报。
senses.why: One department is a single rein of the firm, and its head pulls only that one.
senses.whyCN: 一个部门只是公司的一根缰绳，它的负责人只拉这一根。

senses.title: Boss of a sports team
senses.titleCN: 运动队的领队或主教练
senses.definition: the person who picks the players and directs a team during matches
senses.definitionCN: 挑选球员并在比赛中指挥球队的人
senses.example: The manager changed formation after the first goal.
senses.exampleCN: 第一个球之后，主教练换了阵型。
senses.why: The Italian verb behind the word was used of training horses, so a team boss keeps the oldest sense alive.
senses.whyCN: 这个词背后的意大利语动词用于驯马，因此球队主帅保留了最古老的那层意思。

senses.title: Business agent for performers
senses.titleCN: 艺人或乐队的事务代理人
senses.definition: someone who handles contracts, bookings and money for a performer or group
senses.definitionCN: 替艺人或团体处理合同、演出安排与收入的人
senses.example: Her manager turned down the film offer on her behalf.
senses.exampleCN: 她的经纪人替她推掉了那部电影的邀约。
senses.why: A performer needs someone to handle contracts the way a rider handles the direction of a horse.
senses.whyCN: 艺人需要有人替他打理合同，就像骑手替马把握方向。

senses.title: Someone who looks after another's money or property
senses.titleCN: 替他人打理钱财产业的人
senses.definition: a person employed to look after money, land or property for its owner
senses.definitionCN: 受雇替业主照管钱财、土地或房产的人
senses.example: The estate manager hires the gardeners and pays the bills.
senses.exampleCN: 产业经理雇请园丁，并支付各项账单。
senses.why: Money and land are things a hand holds on another's behalf, so the handler is named after the hand.
senses.whyCN: 钱财与土地是手替别人握着的东西，因此这个代管者以「手」来命名。

senses.title: A program that organizes things
senses.titleCN: 整理文件或窗口的计算机程序
senses.definition: a piece of software that organizes files, windows or settings
senses.definitionCN: 整理文件、窗口或设置的软件
senses.example: The download manager keeps the parts in order.
senses.exampleCN: 下载管理器把各个分段按顺序放好。
senses.why: Software does by rule what a hand did by feel: it keeps the pieces sorted in their places.
senses.whyCN: 软件用规则去做手凭手感做的事：把各个零碎归到各自的位置。

senses.title: The person in charge of one project
senses.titleCN: 某一项目的专责负责人
senses.definition: the person responsible for one project from start to finish
senses.definitionCN: 从头到尾对某一个项目负责的人
senses.example: The project manager moved the launch back by a month.
senses.exampleCN: 项目经理把上线日期往后推了一个月。
senses.why: A project is one bounded task, and its manager holds only that task until it is finished.
senses.whyCN: 一个项目是一项有边界的工作，项目经理只管这一件，直到它完成。

senses.title: The person in charge of a shop
senses.titleCN: 一家店铺的现场负责人
senses.definition: the person who runs a single shop or branch day to day
senses.definitionCN: 日复一日经营一家店铺或分店的人
senses.example: The store manager counts the till before locking up.
senses.exampleCN: 门店经理在锁门前清点收银账目。
senses.why: A shop is a small ring of work, and one person keeps that ring turning every day.
senses.whyCN: 一家店是一个小小的循环，一个人每天让它转起来。

intro.en: Manager adds the agent suffix to manage, a word that came from Italian horse handling. The role names grew apart as firms, clubs and estates each needed a handler.
intro.cn: manager 在 manage 之后加上施动后缀；manage 来自意大利语的驯马行话。随着公司、俱乐部与产业各自需要有人打理，这个称呼分化出不同角色。

items.en: Manus 'hand' also carried the idea of control, which is why a handler and a controller share one root.
items.cn: manus「手」同时带有掌控之意，因此「动手的人」与「掌控的人」共用同一个词根。

items.en: Maneggiare meant to handle and especially to train a horse; the trainer of horses is the oldest kind of manager.
items.cn: maneggiare 指用手操作，尤指驯马；驯马人就是最古老的一类管理者。

items.en: Manage is recorded in English from the sixteenth century, and manager, the one who manages, from the late sixteenth century; both dates are approximate.
items.cn: manage 在十六世纪见于英语记录，指做这件事的 manager 则见于十六世纪晚期；两个年代都是约数。

items.en: The Old English suffix -er marks the doer of an action, so manager is literally the handling one.
items.cn: 古英语的施动后缀标记动作的执行者，因此 manager 字面上就是「动手打理的那一个」。

items.en: Sports clubs, theatres and country estates gave the word its separate everyday roles in the eighteenth and nineteenth centuries.
items.cn: 体育俱乐部、剧院与乡间产业在十八、十九世纪分别赋予这个词不同的日常角色。

note.en: The first group shares shape or root with manager; the second group names other people who direct work.
note.cn: 第一组与 manager 共享形音或词根；第二组是其他指挥工作的人。

entries.definition: The verb, naming the action rather than the person.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，指动作而不是人。

entries.definition: The activity or the whole body of managers, not one individual.
entries.definitionCN: 指这项活动或整个管理层，不是单个个人。

entries.definition: A riding school, from the same Italian word for handling horses.
entries.definitionCN: 马术学校，同出那个表示驯马的意大利词。

entries.definition: From Dutch manneken 'little man'; the shared shape is accidental, and it names a dummy.
entries.definitionCN: 来自荷兰语 manneken「小人」；形似只是巧合，它指服装模特或假人。

entries.definition: One who watches over workers directly; the emphasis is on checking, not on running the whole unit.
entries.definitionCN: 直接看管工人的人，强调检查，而不是经营整个单元。

entries.definition: One who runs an institution's procedures and records; the focus is rules and paper.
entries.definitionCN: 维持机构程序与记录的人，重心在规章与文书。

entries.definition: A member of the top board or the head of a whole organization.
entries.definitionCN: 董事会成员或整个机构的负责人。

entries.definition: An informal word for whoever gives orders; it says nothing about handling work well.
entries.definitionCN: 指发号施令者的口语词，并不含「把工作打理得好」的意思。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations use the real suffix, the real word family and real job titles.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想使用真实的后缀、真实的同族词与真实的职位名称。

normal.en: Manus is hand, and -er is the doer, so manager is the one with a hand on the work.
normal.cn: manus 是手，施动后缀指做事的人，manager 就是那只按在工作上的手。

normal.en: The family runs manage, management, managerial and managership.
normal.cn: 同族词有 manage、management、managerial 与 managership。

normal.en: Real titles show the spread: store manager, project manager, sales manager.
normal.cn: 真实职位显示它的分布：门店经理、项目经理、销售经理。

normal.en: The oldest picture is a horse trainer, because the Italian verb meant exactly that.
normal.cn: 最古老的画面是驯马人，因为那个意大利语动词本就是这个意思。

normal.en: A manager is measured by the work that keeps moving, not by tasks done personally.
normal.cn: 衡量一位经理的，是继续运转的工作，而不是他亲手做完的活儿。

abstract.en: Picture a stagehand who fixes a broken light while the curtain is still closed.
abstract.cn: 想象幕布还没拉开，一名舞台工作人员已经把坏掉的灯修好。

abstract.en: Picture a rider who steers with the knees and leaves both hands free.
abstract.cn: 想象一位用膝盖控向、腾出双手的骑手。

abstract.en: Picture a person standing at the joint of four pipes, turning each valve a little.
abstract.cn: 想象一个人站在四根管道的接合处，把每个阀门都拧一点。

examples.en: The branch manager rewrote the rota so nobody worked six days straight.
examples.cn: 分店经理重排了班表，没人再连上六天。

examples.en: A good manager knows which decisions can wait until Monday.
examples.cn: 好的管理者知道哪些决定可以等到周一再做。

examples.en: The band's manager cancelled the tour rather than cut the fee.
examples.cn: 乐队经纪人宁可取消巡演，也不肯压低酬劳。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「man（人）+ ager（上年纪的人）」——公司里管人又上了年纪的那位，就是经理

root: 拉丁 manus「手」→ 意大利 maneggiare「驯马、操作」→ 英语 manage「管理」+ 施动后缀「做事的人」。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one hand from a whole firm down to a single shop: the general runner, a department head, a team boss, an agent for another, a keeper of property, a sorting program, one project and one counter.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项沿着同一只手，从整个公司缩小到一家店铺：总管、部门负责人、球队主帅、代他人打理事务者、产业代管人、整理文件的程序、单个项目、一个柜台。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: one hand on the rein, with a line of people and tasks behind it.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只手握着缰绳，身后是一队人与一列待办的事。

branches.en: THE WHOLE REIN: the general manager holds every part of the business at once.
branches.cn: 整根缰绳：总经理同时握住企业的每一部分。

branches.en: TWO KINDS OF CAPTAIN: one leads a department, the other leads players.
branches.cn: 两种带队人：一个带部门，一个带球员。

branches.en: ACTING FOR ANOTHER: an agent handles a career, an estate manager handles property.
branches.cn: 代他人出手：经纪人打理职业生涯，产业经理打理房产。

branches.en: ORGANIZING INSTRUMENTS: software sorts files, a project lead sorts tasks.
branches.cn: 整理的工具：软件归置文件，项目负责人归置任务。

branches.en: ONE SMALL RING: a single shop is the smallest circle a manager keeps turning.
branches.cn: 最小的循环：一家店铺是经理让它转动的最小一圈。

intro.en: Manager is a Latin-rooted verb plus an English agent suffix, and the same root reaches several everyday words.
intro.cn: manager 是一个拉丁词根的动词加上英语施动后缀，这个词根还通向若干日常词。

latinIntro.en: Latin manus gives manual, manacle and mandate; the Italian verb gives manage and its English family.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 manus 衍生 manual、manacle 与 mandate；意大利语动词衍生 manage 及其英语词族。

items.example: The root supplies the hand that holds the work.
items.exampleCN: 这个词根提供握持工作的那只手。

items.meaning: to handle; to train a horse
items.example: The horse trainer is the oldest manager.
items.exampleCN: 驯马人是最古老的管理者。

items.example: The verb names the action behind every manager.
items.exampleCN: 这个动词命名每位经理背后的动作。

items.example: The suffix marks the doer, not the deed.
items.exampleCN: 后缀标出执行者，而不是动作。

items.example: The noun names the activity the manager performs.
items.exampleCN: 名词指经理所做的这项活动。

items.example: The adjective shifts the focus from person to practice.
items.exampleCN: 形容词把人换成做法。

items.example: The suffix names the office rather than the person.
items.exampleCN: 后缀指职位，不指人。

items.example: A load one hand can hold is manageable.
items.exampleCN: 一只手能握住的量就是可控的。

items.meaningCN: 表示动作执行者的后缀
items.example: It also builds teacher, driver and keeper.
items.exampleCN: 它也构成「教师」「司机」与「看守者」等词。

definition_zh: （用手）熟练操作；摆弄；操控（他人）；篡改（数据）；操纵（市场、局势）
definition_en: to handle or control something skillfully with the hands or instruments, or to influence people, information, or markets in a controlled and often hidden way
core_image: 指腹捏住一团黏土，表面不动声色，形状却被一点点改成自己想要的样子
scene: 诊室里，医生让病人放松手腕。He used his thumb along the joint space to manipulate the small displaced joint and push it back into place.
sceneCN: 这里 manipulate 是「医疗手法复位」（第 3 个义项：用手法调整骨骼、关节）；句意：他用拇指沿骨缝把错位的小关节推回原位。图中可辨识物件：诊床、病人的手腕、医生的拇指、关节模型。

pos.zh: 熟练操作；摆弄；操控；篡改；操纵

collocations.zh: 把某人摆布得去做某事

derivatives.zh: 操作；操控；篡改；手法治疗
操纵他人的；控制的；手法操作的

senses.title: Skilled handling: shape something with the hands
senses.titleCN: 巧手处理：用手把材料做成形
senses.definition: to handle, move, or shape something skillfully with the hands
senses.definitionCN: 用手熟练地拿捏、移动或塑造某物
senses.example: The sculptor manipulated the wet clay into a narrow face.
senses.exampleCN: 雕塑家把湿黏土捏成一张瘦长的脸。
senses.why: Manipulate was back-formed from manipulation in 1827 and first meant 'to handle skillfully by hand'. The Latin source manipulus is literally 'a handful', so the hand is not a metaphor here but the original instrument.
senses.whyCN: manipulate 于 1827 年由 manipulation 逆构而来，最初意为“用手熟练处理”。拉丁语来源 manipulus 字面就是“一把”，所以这里的“手”不是比喻，而是最初的工具。

senses.title: Operate a tool or control with practiced skill
senses.titleCN: 熟练操作工具或控制装置
senses.definition: to operate a device, machine, or set of controls with learned skill
senses.definitionCN: 以习得的技巧操作装置、机器或一组控制件
senses.example: Only two technicians can manipulate the robotic arm safely.
senses.exampleCN: 只有两名技术员能安全地操作这条机械臂。
senses.why: Once the hand works through a tool, the skill moves from fingers to procedure. The object is no longer clay but a lever, a switch or a joystick, and manipulation becomes trained operation.
senses.whyCN: 当手通过工具工作时，技巧就从指尖转移到程序上。被处理的不再是黏土，而是操纵杆、开关或摇杆，manipulation 于是变成受过训练的操作。

senses.title: Medical handling: put a joint or bone back
senses.titleCN: 医疗手法：把关节或骨头归位
senses.definition: to adjust or reduce a joint, bone, or tissue by hand as a treatment
senses.definitionCN: 以手调整或复位关节、骨骼、组织，作为治疗手段
senses.example: The doctor manipulated the dislocated finger back into place.
senses.exampleCN: 医生把脱位的手指手法复位。
senses.why: Here the hand applies controlled force inside the body rather than on an object. The sense stays neutral and technical: manipulation in medicine is a procedure, not a trick.
senses.whyCN: 这里手在身体内部施加受控的力量，而不是作用在物体上。这个义项保持中性、技术化：医学里的 manipulation 是一项操作，而不是花招。

senses.title: Influence a person behind the surface
senses.titleCN: 在表面之下影响一个人
senses.definition: to influence a person's feelings or decisions in a hidden, indirect, often selfish way
senses.definitionCN: 以隐蔽、间接、常为私利的方式影响他人的情感或决定
senses.example: He manipulated his colleagues into supporting a plan they did not understand.
senses.exampleCN: 他摆布同事们去支持一个他们并不理解的计划。
senses.why: The sense 'to manage by mental influence, especially for one's own purposes' is recorded by 1864, after an 1828 extension to 'handling persons'. The hand now moves feelings instead of clay, and the hidden grip is what makes the word negative.
senses.whyCN: “以心理影响加以摆布，尤指为私利”的义项记录于 1864 年，此前 1828 年已从物件扩展到“摆布人”。此时手移动的是情绪而非黏土，那只看不见的手正是这个词带贬义的原因。

senses.title: Falsify information: make the record say what you want
senses.titleCN: 篡改信息：让记录说出自己想要的话
senses.definition: to change data, accounts, images, or records dishonestly so that they mislead
senses.definitionCN: 不诚实地改动数据、账目、图像或记录，使其误导他人
senses.example: The company manipulated its sales figures before the audit.
senses.exampleCN: 公司在审计前篡改了销售数字。
senses.why: Numbers are soft material for a skilled hand. The financial sense appears by 1870, and it keeps the original structure: a handful is quietly reshaped until the total looks right.
senses.whyCN: 数字对熟练的手而言是柔软的材料。金融义在 1870 年出现，保留了最初的结构：悄悄把“一把”数字捏到总数看起来正确为止。

senses.title: Rig a market or an outcome
senses.definition: to control prices, competition, or a result artificially, usually for profit
senses.definitionCN: 人为控制价格、竞争或结果，通常为获利
senses.example: Regulators found that traders had manipulated the price of electricity.
senses.exampleCN: 监管机构认定交易员操纵了电价。
senses.why: A market is a system of many hands, and manipulation means one hand quietly sets the scale for everyone else. The word still describes control exercised from behind, not open bargaining.
senses.whyCN: 市场是许多只手组成的系统，manipulation 意味着一只手悄悄替所有人定下刻度。这个词描述的仍是从背后施加的控制，而不是公开的讨价还价。

senses.title: Control variables in an experiment or system
senses.titleCN: 控制实验或系统中的变量
senses.definition: in science and computing, to change or control variables, parameters, or data structures deliberately
senses.definitionCN: 在科学与计算中，有意识地改变或控制变量、参数或数据结构
senses.example: The model lets researchers manipulate one variable while holding the rest fixed.
senses.exampleCN: 这个模型让研究者固定其余变量、只操纵一个变量。
senses.why: This is manipulation without deception: the hand is visible and the purpose is stated. The technical sense shows that the word's negativity comes from intent and concealment, not from control itself.
senses.whyCN: 这是没有欺骗的 manipulation：手是看得见的，目的也说明白。这个技术义说明，这个词的贬义来自意图与隐瞒，而不是来自“控制”本身。

senses.title: Usage boundary: neutral skill vs hidden control
senses.titleCN: 用法边界：中性技巧与暗中控制
senses.definition: manipulate can be neutral when the object is a material, tool, joint, or variable, but is pejorative when the object is a person, information, or a market; it is stronger and more secretive than handle or manage
senses.definitionCN: 当对象是材料、工具、关节或变量时可为中性；当对象是人、信息或市场时带贬义；它比 handle 或 manage 更强，也更强调暗中进行
senses.example: A surgeon manipulates tissue; a demagogue manipulates fear. The verb is the same, the ethics are not.
senses.exampleCN: 外科医生 manipulate 组织；煽动者 manipulate 恐惧。动词相同，伦理不同。
senses.why: English kept one verb for both because the physical gesture is identical: a hand takes hold and directs. The usage note is the boundary: neutral when the object cannot consent, pejorative when it can.
senses.whyCN: 英语让同一个动词覆盖两者，因为手上的动作完全相同：一只手抓住并引导。用法要点就是那条边界：对象无法同意时是中性的，对象能同意时就是贬义的。

intro.en: Manipulate is a back-formation from manipulation, a word first used for handling ore. Its Latin core is manipulus 'a handful', from manus 'hand'. The second part of manipulus is often linked to 'fill', but that link is not certain.
intro.cn: manipulate 是由 manipulation 逆构而来的词，后者最初用于处理矿石。其拉丁核心是 manipulus“一把”，来自 manus“手”。manipulus 的第二部分常被联系到“填满”，但这一联系并不确定。

items.en: Manipulation is recorded by 1730 as a method of digging or handling ore, from French manipulation. The earliest English use is technical, not psychological.
items.cn: manipulation 于 1730 年记录为一种挖掘、处理矿石的方法，来自法语 manipulation。最早的英语用法是技术性的，而非心理层面的。

items.en: From Latin manipulus 'handful, sheaf, bundle', also a pharmacists' measure. The first element is manus 'hand'; the second is often connected with plere 'to fill', but the etymology of that second element is source uncertain.
items.cn: 来自拉丁语 manipulus“一把、一束、一捆”，也是药剂师的量名。第一成分是 manus“手”；第二成分常与 plere“填满”联系，但该第二成分的词源来源不确定。

items.en: manus is traced to PIE *man- (2) 'hand'. This reconstruction is generally accepted. Because the second element of manipulus is uncertain, no full PIE shape should be asserted for the whole word.
items.cn: manus 被追溯到原始印欧语 *man-（第二支）“手”，这一重构属于一般认为。由于 manipulus 的第二成分不确定，不应为整词断言完整的原始印欧语形式。

items.en: Manipulate is recorded as a back-formation meaning 'to handle skillfully by hand'. The verb was cut from the noun, so the noun is older than the verb.
items.cn: manipulate 作为逆构词记录于 1827 年，意为“用手熟练处理”。动词是从名词上“切”下来的，因此名词比动词更早。

items.en: The sense extends to 'handling or managing persons' by 1828, to mental influence for one's own purposes by 1864, and to financial manipulation by 1870.
items.cn: 词义于 1828 年扩展到“摆布、管理人”，1864 年扩展到“为私利施加心理影响”，1870 年扩展到金融上的操纵。

items.en: Modern English uses one verb for the sculptor, the surgeon, the scientist, the fraudster and the demagogue. The neutral and the pejorative readings are separated by the object and by whether the control is admitted.
items.cn: 现代英语用同一个动词覆盖雕塑家、外科医生、科学家、造假者与煽动者。中性义与贬义由对象决定，也由这种控制是否被承认决定。

note.en: The first group shares the manus 'hand' family or the manip- shape. The second group separates physical handling, technical operation, neutral control and dishonest rigging.
note.cn: 第一组共享 manus“手”词族或 manip- 词形。第二组区分实体拿捏、技术操作、中性控制与不诚实的操纵。

entries.definition: the noun from manipulate: skilled handling, medical adjustment, or hidden control. It is older than the verb.
entries.definitionCN: manipulate 的名词：熟练操作、医疗手法或暗中操控。它比动词更早出现。

entries.definition: using hidden influence to control people. It almost always carries disapproval, unlike the neutral verb.
entries.definitionCN: 用隐蔽影响控制他人的。它几乎总带贬义，而动词本身可以是中性的。

entries.definition: care for the hands and nails. It joins manus 'hand' with cura 'care', a different second element from manipulus.
entries.definitionCN: 手部与指甲护理。它由 manus“手”+ cura“照料”构成，第二成分与 manipulus 不同。

entries.definition: to hold, move, or deal with something with the hands. It is neutral and lacks the hidden-control sense.
entries.definitionCN: 用手拿、移动或处理某物。它中性，没有“暗中控制”的含义。

entries.definition: to run a machine or system. It covers the technical sense of manipulate but says nothing about skill or secrecy.
entries.definitionCN: 操作机器或系统。它覆盖 manipulate 的技术义，但不含技巧高低或秘密性的意味。

entries.definition: to direct or limit something. It is broader and more neutral than manipulate, which implies indirect or unfair direction.
entries.definitionCN: 指挥或限制某事物。它比 manipulate 更宽、更中性，后者隐含间接或不正当的引导。

entries.definition: to arrange a competition, price, or vote dishonestly. It is narrower and more openly criminal than manipulate.
entries.definitionCN: 不诚实地安排比赛、价格或投票。它比 manipulate 更窄，也更明确指向违法。

normalIntro.en: Real parts and real relatives: manus 'hand' gives manual, manuscript, manufacture and manicure; manipulus 'a handful' gives manipulate and manipulation.
normalIntro.cn: 真实构词与真实同族词：manus“手”给出 manual、manuscript、manufacture、manicure；manipulus“一把”给出 manipulate 与 manipulation。

normal.en: manipulus is 'a handful'. Manipulate began as the act of working a handful of material, and the hand stayed in the word.
normal.cn: manipulus 就是“一把”。manipulate 最初是处理“一把”材料的动作，那只手一直留在词里。

normal.en: The noun came first: manipulation (1730, ore handling), then the verb manipulate (1827). The verb was cut down from the noun.
normal.cn: 名词先出现：manipulation（1730，处理矿石），然后才是动词 manipulate（1827）。动词是从名词上截下来的。

normal.en: Medical manipulation is neutral: a hand puts a joint back. The same word turns negative only when the hand works on a mind or a record.
normal.cn: 医学上的 manipulation 是中性的：手把关节归位。只有当这只手作用于头脑或记录时，同一个词才转为贬义。

normal.en: Manipulate data and manipulate public opinion share one image: adjusting the material until the result looks natural.
normal.cn: manipulate data 与 manipulate public opinion 共享一个意象：把材料调到结果看起来自然为止。

normal.en: Manicure, manual and manuscript all contain manus 'hand': nail care, hand work, and a book small enough for one hand.
normal.cn: manicure、manual、manuscript 都含 manus“手”：指甲护理、手工操作，以及一只手就能拿的小书。

abstract.en: Picture a hand under a cloth moving pieces on a board. Everyone sees the board; no one sees the fingers. Manipulate is control whose source stays out of sight.
abstract.cn: 想象一块布下有一只手在挪动棋盘上的棋子。所有人都看见棋盘，没人看见手指。manipulate 就是来源始终藏在视线之外的控制。

abstract.en: The same grip works on clay, a lever, a joint, a number, a price or a feeling. The material changes; the quiet adjusting does not.
abstract.cn: 同一种捏握可以作用于黏土、操纵杆、关节、数字、价格或情绪。材料在变，那种无声的调整没有变。

abstract.en: When the object can say no, the hand becomes a moral problem; when it cannot, the hand is only skill. That line runs through every sense.
abstract.cn: 当对象能说“不”时，这只手就成了道德问题；当对象不能说“不”时，这只手只是技巧。这条线贯穿所有义项。

examples.en: The puppeteer manipulates the strings with two fingers.
examples.cn: 木偶师用两根手指操纵提线。

examples.en: The audit showed that several entries had been manipulated.
examples.cn: 审计显示有多笔账目被篡改过。

examples.en: Advertisers manipulate desire long before they mention the product.
examples.cn: 广告商在提到产品之前，早就在操控欲望了。

dict_mnemonic.text: “马尼扑雷特”——马尼一把扑住雷特的手腕，把他摆布得团团转 → manipulate 摆弄、操控

root: 由 manipulation 逆构；拉丁语 manipulus“一把、一束”来自 manus“手”，核心是“用手握住材料并加以摆弄、引导”。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses of manipulate, one hand at work: shaping clay, operating a control, setting a joint, steering a person, rewriting a record, rigging a market, holding a variable fixed, and the boundary where skill becomes manipulation.
sensesIntro.cn: manipulate 的八个义项都是同一只手在工作：捏黏土、扳操纵杆、复位关节、牵引他人、改写记录、操纵市场、固定变量，以及技巧变成“操控”的那条边界。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a hand takes hold of material and quietly directs its shape.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只手握住材料，悄悄决定它的形状。

branches.en: MATERIAL AND TOOL: clay and controls are both held and moved by practiced fingers.
branches.cn: 材料与工具：黏土和操纵装置都是被熟练手指握住并移动的对象。

branches.en: BODY: the hand works inside the body, but as a neutral medical procedure.
branches.cn: 身体：手在身体内部工作，但作为中性的医疗程序。

branches.en: MIND: the grip moves to feelings and decisions, and concealment makes it negative.
branches.cn: 心智：捏握转向情感与决定，隐瞒使它变成贬义。

branches.en: RECORDS AND MARKETS: numbers and prices are soft material, reshaped until the result looks natural.
branches.cn: 记录与市场：数字和价格是柔软的材料，被捏到结果看起来自然为止。

branches.en: SYSTEMS AND BOUNDARY: a declared variable is neutral control, and the object decides whether the word is an accusation.
branches.cn: 系统与边界：公开说明的变量是中性的控制，而对象决定这个词是否是指控。

intro.en: Manipulate has no live English prefix. Its Latin core manipulus is frozen inside, and English adds only -ion, -ive, -or and -able to the finished verb.
intro.cn: manipulate 没有活的英语前缀。它的拉丁核心 manipulus 凝固在词内，英语只在成品动词后加 -ion、-ive、-or、-able。

latinIntro.en: The Latin family is built on manus 'hand': manual and manuscript work by hand, manufacture is made by hand, and manicure cares for the hand. Manipulus adds the 'handful' measure.
latinIntro.cn: 这一拉丁词族建立在 manus“手”上：manual 与 manuscript 与手有关，manufacture 是“手做”，manicure 是照料手。manipulus 再加上“一把”这个量。

items.structure: Latin manipulus (handful) + -ation (noun of action); the verb is a back-formation
items.meaning: the act of handling skillfully, adjusting by hand, or controlling dishonestly
items.meaningCN: 操作；手法调整；操控（-ion 构成行为名词）
items.example: Careful manipulation of the evidence was later exposed.
items.exampleCN: 对证据的精心篡改后来被揭露了。

items.meaning: tending to control people indirectly and unfairly
items.meaningCN: 善于操控他人的；工于心计的（-ive 表示倾向）
items.example: His manipulative emails made the team distrust him.
items.exampleCN: 他那些操控性的邮件让团队不再信任他。

items.meaning: a person who controls others, or a device for handling objects
items.meaningCN: 操纵者；操作器；机械手（-or 表示做该动作的人或装置）
items.example: The remote manipulator picks up samples in the glove box.
items.exampleCN: 遥控机械手在手套箱里取样。

items.meaning: able to be handled or controlled
items.meaningCN: 可操作的；可被操控的（-able 表示“能够被……”）
items.example: In this model every parameter is manipulable.
items.exampleCN: 在这个模型里，每个参数都可以被操纵。

items.example: The hand is the base of the whole family.
items.exampleCN: “手”是整个词族的基础。

items.example: The noun gave the verb its image of handling.
items.exampleCN: 这个名词给动词“握持”的意象。

items.example: It forms the verb from the noun of handling.
items.exampleCN: 它由“握持”名词构成动词。

items.example: It forms manipulation, the act of handling.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 manipulation，即操控行为。

items.meaning: a handful; a small detachment of soldiers
items.meaningCN: 一小队士兵；（祭司佩戴的）饰带
items.example: The Roman maniple was a small tactical unit.
items.exampleCN: 罗马的 maniple 是一个小型战术单位。

latinEntries.meaning: done by hand; a handbook small enough to hold
latinEntries.meaningCN: 手工的；手册（原义“可一手拿的小书”）

latinEntries.meaning: a document written by hand rather than printed
latinEntries.meaningCN: 手稿；手写本（手写的文字）

latinEntries.meaning: to make goods, originally by hand
care for the hands and nails
latinEntries.meaningCN: 手部护理；修指甲（照料手）

definition_zh: 地幔；披风，斗篷；覆盖层；承担（职责、衣钵）
definition_en: the rocky layer between Earth's crust and core; also a loose cloak or a covering layer
core_image: 一件厚斗篷从肩头垂下把身体整个裹住，地球内部也有一层岩石斗篷裹住地核
scene: 深洋底下的岩石受热缓慢上升，又向两侧摊开。Hot rock rises through the mantle and spreads beneath the ocean floor.
sceneCN: 这里 mantle 指「地幔」（第 1 个义项：地壳与地核之间的岩石层）；句意为炽热的岩石穿过地幔上升，并在海底之下向两侧扩散。

pos.zh: 地幔；披风；覆盖层；外套膜；纱罩
覆盖；笼罩
（雾、雪等）铺展开来盖住表面

derivatives.zh: 纹章上环绕盾牌的垂饰
小掩体；可移动的防护屏

senses.title: The rocky layer below the crust
senses.titleCN: 地幔：地壳之下的岩石层
senses.definition: the thick layer of hot rock between Earth's crust and its core
senses.definitionCN: 地壳与地核之间的厚层炽热岩石
senses.example: Hot rock rises through the mantle and spreads beneath the ocean floor.
senses.exampleCN: 炽热的岩石穿过地幔上升，并在海底之下向两侧扩散。
senses.why: The geological sense borrows the cloak image: the mantle wraps around the core the way a cloak wraps a body.
senses.whyCN: 地质义借用了「斗篷」的形象：地幔像斗篷裹住身体那样包住地核。

senses.title: A loose cloak
senses.titleCN: 披风：披在肩上的宽大外套
senses.definition: a loose sleeveless cloak worn over other clothes
senses.definitionCN: 披在其他衣服外面的宽松无袖外套
senses.example: She drew her mantle closer against the wind.
senses.exampleCN: 她把披风裹紧以挡风。
senses.why: The word entered English as the name of a cloak, and every later sense grows out of that garment.
senses.whyCN: 这个词最初进入英语时就是「斗篷」的名称，后来所有义项都从这件衣服生长出来。

senses.title: A covering layer
senses.titleCN: 覆盖层：像被子一样盖住表面的东西
senses.definition: a layer of something that covers a surface completely
senses.definitionCN: 完全盖住某一表面的一层东西
senses.example: A mantle of snow lay over the valley.
senses.exampleCN: 一层白雪覆盖着山谷。
senses.why: A cloak covers a body and snow covers a valley; the shape of covering is the same in both cases.
senses.whyCN: 斗篷盖住身体，雪盖住山谷，两种情形里「覆盖」的形状是一样的。

senses.title: To cover or envelop
senses.definition: to cover something as if with a cloak
senses.definitionCN: 像盖上一件斗篷那样罩住某物
senses.example: Thick fog mantled the harbor at dawn.
senses.exampleCN: 黎明时浓雾笼罩着港口。
senses.why: The noun turned into a verb: to mantle something is simply to put a mantle on it.
senses.whyCN: 名词转成了动词：mantle 某物就是给它盖上一层斗篷。

senses.title: To take on a role or duty
senses.definition: to take on a role, duty or tradition passed down from someone else
senses.definitionCN: 接过别人传下来的角色、职责或传统
senses.example: She took up the mantle of the retiring director.
senses.exampleCN: 她接过了退休主管的职责。
senses.why: The image comes from a cloak handed from one person to another, as a prophet's mantle passes to a successor.
senses.whyCN: 这个形象来自斗篷由一人传给另一人，正如先知的衣钵传给继承者。

senses.title: The mantle of a mollusk
senses.titleCN: 外套膜：软体动物包住内脏的膜
senses.definition: the fold of tissue that lines the shell of a mollusk
senses.definitionCN: 软体动物体内贴着壳的那层组织褶
senses.example: The oyster deposits new shell along its mantle.
senses.exampleCN: 牡蛎沿着外套膜沉积新的壳。
senses.why: Biologists reused the cloak image for the tissue sheet that wraps the animal's body.
senses.whyCN: 生物学家借「斗篷」的形象，指包住动物身体的那层组织。

senses.title: A gas mantle
senses.titleCN: 纱罩：燃气灯里发光的网罩
senses.definition: a mesh that glows when a gas flame heats it
senses.definitionCN: 被燃气火焰烧热后发光的网状罩子
senses.example: The old lamp still had a fragile gas mantle.
senses.exampleCN: 那盏旧灯上还装着一个易碎的纱罩。
senses.why: The mesh is a sleeve slipped over the flame, so the cloak image fits again.
senses.whyCN: 网罩是套在火焰外面的套子，斗篷的形象又一次贴合。

senses.title: An abstract veil
senses.definition: something that hides or surrounds a situation, such as secrecy or silence
senses.definitionCN: 遮住或围住某种情形的抽象之物，如保密或沉默
senses.example: The negotiations were wrapped in a mantle of secrecy.
senses.exampleCN: 谈判被一层保密的帷幕包住。
senses.why: When the covering is not physical, mantle names whatever keeps a matter out of sight.
senses.whyCN: 当覆盖物不是实物时，mantle 就指把某件事挡在视线之外的东西。

intro.en: Mantle goes back to a Latin word for a cloak. The clothing sense is old; the geological and biological senses are later extensions of the same covering image. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: mantle 可追溯到拉丁语中表示「斗篷」的词。衣物义很古老，地质义与生物义是同一「覆盖」形象的后起延伸。年代均为约数。

items.en: Latin mantellum, also written mantum, meant 'a cloak or veil'. Its deeper origin is uncertain; some references suggest a Gaulish or Celtic source for the covering sense.
items.cn: 拉丁语 mantellum（也写作 mantum）意为「斗篷、面纱」。它更早的来源不确定，有资料认为「覆盖物」这一义可能来自高卢语或凯尔特语。

items.en: The ending of mantellum looks like a diminutive suffix, but whether it really is one remains disputed, so the word is best treated as a single lexical item.
items.cn: mantellum 的词尾看起来像指小后缀，但它是否真是指小形式仍有争议，因此最好把这个词当作一个整体词项处理。

items.en: Old French mantel carried the cloak sense into English, where the spelling later became mantle.
items.cn: 古法语 mantel 把「斗篷」义带入英语，拼写后来固定为 mantle。

items.en: Middle English used mantle for a sleeveless outer garment and already for any protective covering, including figurative ones.
items.cn: 中古英语用 mantle 指无袖外衣，并且已经用它指任何保护性覆盖物，包括比喻用法。

items.en: Geologists extended the cloak image to the rocky layer around the core, while biologists used it for the tissue sheet of mollusks; the phrase 'take up the mantle' comes from the biblical story of Elijah's cloak passing to Elisha.
items.cn: 地质学家把斗篷的形象延伸指包住地核的岩石层，生物学家则用它指软体动物那层组织；短语 take up the mantle 出自《列王纪》中以利亚的斗篷传给以利沙的故事。

note.en: Group one lists words that sound or look close to mantle; group two lists words that also describe a covering, with a different emphasis.
note.cn: 第一组是与 mantle 读音或拼写相近的词；第二组是同样表示「覆盖物」但侧重点不同的词。

entries.definition: the shelf above a fireplace. It is a different word with a different spelling: -el, not -le.
entries.definitionCN: 壁炉上方的搁架。它是另一个词，拼写也不同：结尾是 -el，不是 -le。

entries.definition: relating to the mind. The first vowel is /e/, not /æ/, and there is no -tle ending.
entries.definitionCN: 与心理、精神有关的。第一个元音是 /e/ 而不是 /æ/，结尾也不是 -tle。

entries.definition: a praying insect with long front legs. It shares the opening man- but ends in -tis.
entries.definitionCN: 螳螂，前足很长的昆虫。它与 mantle 共享开头 man-，但结尾是 -tis。

entries.definition: to crush or tear something badly. It has a hard /ŋɡ/ in the middle that mantle does not have.
entries.definitionCN: 把东西压坏或撕坏。它中间有 mantle 所没有的 /ŋɡ/ 音。

entries.definition: a sleeveless outer garment, closer to a coat than to a loose mantle; it also means something that hides.
entries.definitionCN: 无袖外衣，比宽松的披风更接近大衣；也可指起遮蔽作用的东西。

entries.definition: a thin cloth worn over the face, or anything that hides a view; the emphasis is on concealment, not warmth.
entries.definitionCN: 遮面的薄纱，或任何挡住视线的东西；重点在「遮蔽」，不在保暖。

entries.definition: a cloth used to wrap a body, or a layer that completely envelops something.
entries.definitionCN: 裹尸布，或把某物完全包住的一层东西。

entries.definition: the neutral word for anything placed over an object; it carries no image of a garment or a shell.
entries.definitionCN: 表示「盖在上面」的中性词，不带衣物或外壳的形象。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real spellings, real compounds and real images, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的拼写、真实的复合词和真实的形象，而不是编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: mantle and mantel are homophones: a mantel is the shelf over a fireplace, while a mantle is the cloak; the shelf is a board, the cloak is clothing.
normal.cn: mantle 与 mantel 同音：mantel 是壁炉上的搁架，mantle 是斗篷；搁架是木板，斗篷是衣物。

normal.en: The Earth's mantle is literally the planet's cloak: it wraps around the core and keeps the heat in.
normal.cn: 地幔就是地球的斗篷：它包住地核，把热量留在里面。

normal.en: 'Take up the mantle' comes from the story of Elijah's cloak falling to Elisha, so the phrase means inheriting another person's task.
normal.cn: take up the mantle 出自以利亚的斗篷落到以利沙身上的故事，所以这个短语表示继承他人的事业。

normal.en: A mantle of snow is a blanket of snow: the same word covers a valley and a shoulder.
normal.cn: a mantle of snow 就是一层雪被：同一个词既盖住山谷，也盖住肩膀。

normal.en: A mollusk's mantle is the tissue that lines its shell, like a coat lining the body.
normal.cn: 软体动物的外套膜是贴着壳的那层组织，就像给身体做衬里的外套。

abstract.en: Abstractly, mantle means one layer wrapping another: a core is always inside, and the mantle is always the outermost skin that holds it.
abstract.cn: 抽象地看，mantle 表示一层包住另一层：核心总在里面，而 mantle 总是包住它的最外层皮。

abstract.en: From clothing to the Earth to a handed-down duty, the constant is enclosure: something is kept inside a boundary.
abstract.cn: 从衣物到地球再到传下来的职责，不变的是「包围」：某物被留在一个边界之内。

abstract.en: The symbol is a filled circle inside a ring: ○ around ●, the ring being the mantle.
abstract.cn: 符号是一个圆核外面套一个环：○ 包住 ●，外环就是 mantle。

examples.en: Convection in the mantle slowly moves the plates above it.
examples.cn: 地幔中的对流缓慢地推动着上面的板块。

examples.en: He wore a dark mantle over his shoulders.
examples.cn: 他肩上披着一件深色斗篷。

examples.en: After the founder retired, his daughter took up the mantle.
examples.cn: 创始人退休后，他的女儿接过了衣钵。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「曼特」—— 曼妙的斗篷披在肩上，把身体整个包住 → mantle 披风、覆盖层、地幔

root: 源自拉丁语 mantellum（斗篷、覆盖物），核心含义是「包在外面的覆盖物」。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses of mantle. They all keep one shape: an outer layer that wraps a core, whether the core is a body, a flame, a shell or the Earth.
sensesIntro.cn: mantle 的八个义项都保持同一个形状：外层包住内核，无论内核是身体、火焰、贝壳还是地球。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: an outer layer wrapping a core, from a cloak on a body to rock around the core.
core.cn: 核心意象：外层包住内核，从披在身上的斗篷到包住地核的岩石。

branches.en: CLOTH TO COVER: the cloak becomes any covering layer, then the act of covering.
branches.cn: 从衣物到覆盖：斗篷变成任何覆盖层，再变成覆盖的动作。

branches.en: PHYSICAL SHELLS: the Earth's rocky layer and the glowing mesh both enclose something hot.
branches.cn: 实体外壳：地球的岩石层与发光的网罩都包住某种高温之物。

branches.en: INHERITED ROLE: a cloak passed from one person to another becomes a duty passed down.
branches.cn: 继承的角色：斗篷由一人传给另一人，就变成传下来的职责。

branches.en: BODY TISSUE: biology keeps the wrapping shape but moves it inside the animal.
branches.cn: 身体组织：生物学保留「包裹」的形状，只是把它移到动物体内。

branches.en: ABSTRACT VEIL: when nothing physical is covered, the mantle hides a matter from view.
branches.cn: 抽象帷幕：当没有实物可盖时，mantle 就把一件事挡在视线之外。

intro.en: Mantle is a whole Latin borrowing rather than a native compound, but it still builds a small family of English words and fixed phrases.
intro.cn: mantle 是整个借来的拉丁词，不是英语本族复合词，但它仍构成一小族英语词与固定短语。

latinIntro.en: The Latin source mantellum / mantum supplies the base; English adds -ed, -ing and the diminutive -let, and geology adds compound phrases such as mantle plume.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语来源 mantellum / mantum 提供基础；英语加上 -ed、-ing 与指小后缀 -let，地质学再加 mantle plume 这类复合短语。

items.meaning: the base noun borrowed into English as mantle
items.meaningCN: 作为基础名词被借入英语，成为 mantle
items.example: The Latin noun named a cloak worn over the shoulders.
items.exampleCN: 这个拉丁名词指披在肩上的斗篷。

items.meaning: covered as if by a cloak
items.meaningCN: 被覆盖的（-ed 构成过去分词作形容词）
items.example: The hills were mantled in cloud.
items.exampleCN: 群山被云层覆盖。

items.meaning: drapery arranged around a shield in heraldry
items.meaningCN: 纹章中环绕盾牌的垂饰（-ing 构成动作或结果名词）
items.example: The coat of arms showed elaborate red mantling.
items.exampleCN: 这枚纹章上有繁复的红色垂饰。

items.meaning: a small protective screen or shelter
items.meaningCN: 小型防护屏或掩体（-let 表示指小）
items.example: The gunners crouched behind a steel mantlet.
items.exampleCN: 炮手蹲在一块钢制小掩体后面。

items.meaning: a rising column of hot rock within the mantle
items.meaningCN: 地幔中上升的热岩柱（名词复合）
items.example: A mantle plume can feed volcanic islands far from a plate edge.
items.exampleCN: 地幔柱可以为远离板块边缘的火山岛提供物质。

items.meaning: slow circulation of hot rock inside the mantle
items.meaningCN: 地幔内部热岩的缓慢环流
items.example: Mantle convection is one driver of plate motion.
items.exampleCN: 地幔对流是板块运动的一种驱动力。

items.meaning: the wedge-shaped mantle between a descending slab and the plate above
items.meaningCN: 俯冲板片与上方板块之间的楔形地幔
items.example: Melting in the mantle wedge feeds arc volcanoes.
items.exampleCN: 地幔楔中的熔融为岛弧火山提供岩浆。

items.meaningCN: 源自地幔的（复合形容词）
items.example: The lava is mantle-derived and rich in magnesium.
items.exampleCN: 这种熔岩源自地幔，富含镁。

items.meaning: rock that belongs to the mantle
items.example: Ophiolites expose mantle rock at the surface.
items.exampleCN: 蛇绿岩把地幔岩石暴露到地表。

latinEntries.meaningCN: 披着斗篷的（中世纪拉丁语形容词）

definition_zh: 手工的；手动的；体力的；手册；手动挡汽车；手键盘
definition_en: done or operated by the hands rather than by machine or automatically; as a noun, a book of instructions, a hand-played keyboard, or a car with a manual gearbox
core_image: 一只沾着机油的手掌托着一本薄册：既能亲手操作，也能一手拿起
scene: 修车铺里，技师翻开油污的手册。He opened the oily manual to page forty-two and tightened the bolts with a hand wrench, following the drawing exactly.
sceneCN: 这里 manual 是「手册」（第 4 个义项：一手可持的手册）；句意：他翻开油污的手册到第 42 页，照图示用手动扳手拧紧螺栓。图中可辨识物件：维修手册、扳手、发动机舱、螺栓；对应第 1 个义项。

pos.zh: 手工的；手动的；体力的
手册；说明书；手动挡；手键盘

derivatives.zh: 手语教学法；主张手工训练的教育观点
主张手工训练者；手语教学者
手册化的；按手册标准化操作的

senses.title: Done with the hands, not by machine
senses.titleCN: 用手完成，而非机器完成
senses.definition: done, made, or performed with the hands rather than by machine or tool
senses.definitionCN: 用手而不是机器或工具完成、制作或执行
senses.example: The wall was built by manual labour, stone by stone.
senses.exampleCN: 这堵墙是靠手工劳动一块石头一块石头砌成的。
senses.why: Latin manualis meant 'of or belonging to the hand', from manus 'hand'. The adjective's first job in English, around 1400, was to mark work done by hand, so the hand is the defining instrument.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 manualis 意为“属于手的”，来自 manus“手”。这个形容词约在 1400 年进入英语时的第一项任务，就是标记“用手完成的工作”，因此手是定义性的工具。

senses.title: Hand-operated: a control that bypasses the machine
senses.titleCN: 手动操作：绕开自动装置的控制
senses.definition: of a device or control, operated by physical hand movement rather than automatically
senses.definitionCN: 指装置或控制件靠手的实际动作操作，而不是自动运行
senses.example: If the sensor fails, use the manual override beside the door.
senses.exampleCN: 如果传感器失灵，就用门旁的手动超控装置。
senses.why: Here the contrast is not hand versus machine in general but hand versus automatic. A manual switch exists so that a person can take over from the system, which is why manual also means 'not automatic'.
senses.whyCN: 这里对比的不是泛泛的“手与机器”，而是“手动与自动”。手动开关的存在，就是为了让人能从系统手里接管，因此 manual 也引申为“非自动的”。

senses.title: Physical rather than mental work
senses.titleCN: 体力工作，而非脑力工作
senses.definition: of work or a worker, involving bodily effort rather than office or intellectual work
senses.definitionCN: 指工作或劳动者需要体力，而不是办公室或脑力工作
senses.example: The factory replaced most manual jobs with automated lines.
senses.exampleCN: 工厂用自动化生产线取代了大多数体力岗位。
senses.why: The hand is the body's most obvious working part, so manual work became a social category opposed to head work. The word now describes a class of employment, not just a method.
senses.whyCN: 手是身体最明显的工作部位，因此 manual work 成了与“脑力工作”相对的社会类别。这个词现在描述的是一类就业，而不只是一种方法。

senses.title: The handbook you hold in one hand
senses.definition: a book giving instructions, rules, or reference information for a device, course, or job
senses.definitionCN: 为装置、课程或工作提供说明、规则或参考信息的书
senses.example: Read the manual before you change the filter.
senses.exampleCN: 换滤芯之前先读说明书。
senses.why: The noun is recorded in the early 15c. for a small service book, and by the 1530s for any concise handbook. The etymological picture is a small book that can be carried or used in one hand — the same hand returns.
senses.whyCN: 名词义在 15 世纪早期记录为小型的礼仪书，16 世纪 30 年代起指任何简明手册。词源画面是一本可以随身携带、或一手使用的小书——同一只手又回来了。

senses.title: A car you shift yourself
senses.definition: in informal use, a car with a manual gearbox, as opposed to an automatic
senses.definitionCN: 口语中指带手动变速器的汽车，与自动挡相对
senses.example: I learned to drive on a manual and still prefer one.
senses.exampleCN: 我是开手动挡学会开车的，现在仍然更喜欢手动挡。
senses.why: The adjective manual transmission is shortened to the noun 'a manual'. The hand is now on the gear lever, so the word names the car by the kind of control it demands.
senses.whyCN: 形容词短语 manual transmission 被缩略成名词 a manual。此时手放在换挡杆上，于是这个词用“它要求哪种控制方式”来给车命名。

senses.title: The keyboard played by hand
senses.definition: one of the hand-played keyboards of an organ, as opposed to the pedal keyboard
senses.definitionCN: 管风琴上用手演奏的键盘之一，与脚踏键盘相对
senses.example: The organist moves between the swell manual and the great manual.
senses.exampleCN: 管风琴手在强弱手键盘与主手键盘之间切换。
senses.why: In organ music, manuals are the rows played by hand and the pedals are played by foot. The adjective becomes a noun because the hand is what distinguishes this keyboard from the other.
senses.whyCN: 在管风琴音乐中，manual 是用手弹的键盘排，pedal 是用脚踩的。形容词转为名词，因为“用手”正是这组键盘区别于另一组的地方。

senses.title: The prescribed drill: manual exercise
senses.titleCN: 规定的操练：军事手册操典
senses.definition: in military history, the prescribed routine for handling a rifle or weapon, known as manual exercise
senses.definitionCN: 军事史上规定的步枪或武器操作程序，称为 manual exercise
senses.example: Recruits spent a week learning the manual exercise.
senses.exampleCN: 新兵花了一周学习武器操作操典。
senses.why: Manual exercise is recorded in 1760 as 'the art of handling the rifle and other arms with precision and according to the prescribed method'. Here manual means a fixed sequence performed by hand, not a book.
senses.whyCN: manual exercise 记录于 1760 年，意为“按既定方法精确操作步枪及其他武器的技艺”。这里的 manual 指的是一套用手完成的固定程序，而不是一本书。

senses.title: Usage boundary: manual, hand-made, menial
senses.definition: manual describes hand operation or a handbook; it does not automatically mean unskilled or low-status, and manual is not a synonym of menial
senses.definitionCN: manual 描述用手操作或手册；它不自动表示“无需技能”或“地位低”，也不是 menial 的同义词
senses.example: Manual work can be highly skilled: a watchmaker's hands are manual and expert.
senses.exampleCN: 体力/手工工作也可以高度专业化：制表师的手既是 manual 的，也是专业的。
senses.why: Manual names the instrument (the hand), while menial names the status (low, servile). A manual job may be skilled, and a menial job may involve little handwork at all. The boundary keeps the word technical rather than social.
senses.whyCN: manual 命名的是工具（手），menial 命名的是地位（低微、仆役性）。manual 的工作可能很专业，menial 的工作可能根本不需要多少手工。这条边界让这个词保持技术性，而不是社会评判。

intro.en: Manual is the Latin adjective for 'of the hand'. English first used it for hand-made work, then for hand-operated controls, and turned it into a noun for a small book that fits in one hand — the same hand at both ends.
intro.cn: manual 是拉丁语中表示“属于手的”形容词。英语先用它表示手工完成的工作，再表示手动控制，随后转为名词，指一本能拿在一只手里的小书——两端都是同一只手。

items.en: First recorded as an adjective meaning 'of or pertaining to the hand; done, made, or used by hand', from Latin manualis.
items.cn: 约 1400 年首次记录为形容词，意为“属于手的；用手完成、制作或使用的”，来自拉丁语 manualis。

items.en: Latin manualis 'of or belonging to the hand; that can be thrown by hand', from manus 'hand, strength, power over; armed force; handwriting'.
items.cn: 拉丁语 manualis“属于手的；可以用手投掷的”，来自 manus“手、力量、支配权、武装力量、笔迹”。

items.en: manus is traced to PIE *man- (2) 'hand', the root also listed for manual, manage and manipulate. The reconstruction is generally accepted.
items.cn: manus 被追溯到原始印欧语 *man-（第二支）“手”，也是 manual、manage、manipulate 所列的词根。该重构属于一般认为。

items.en: The noun appears meaning 'small service book used by a priest', from Old French manuel 'handbook' and Late Latin manuale 'case or cover of a book, handbook'.
items.cn: 名词义出现，指“神父使用的小型礼仪书”，来自古法语 manuel“手册”与晚期拉丁语 manuale“书套或书封、手册”。

items.en: The meaning 'a concise handbook of any sort' is recorded from the 1530s. Manual exercise, the prescribed handling of a rifle, appears in 1760.
items.cn: “任何类型的简明手册”义记录于 16 世纪 30 年代。manual exercise（规定的步枪操作）出现于 1760 年。

items.en: Modern English uses manual for hand operation, physical work, a handbook, a manual gearbox and an organ keyboard. The common thread is the hand, not a single object.
items.cn: 现代英语用 manual 表示手动操作、体力工作、手册、手动挡和管风琴手键盘。共同线索是“手”，而不是某一个固定物件。

note.en: The first group shares manus 'hand' or the manual shape. The second group separates the book sense from the hand-operated sense, which English keeps inside one word.
note.cn: 第一组共享 manus“手”或 manual 的词形。第二组把“书”的义项与“用手操作”的义项分开，而英语把它们放在同一个词里。

entries.definition: a metal ring for the wrist; to chain someone. It comes from Latin manicula, a diminutive of manus 'hand'.
entries.definitionCN: 手铐；给某人上镣铐。它来自拉丁语 manicula，是 manus“手”的指小形式。

entries.definition: a text written by hand rather than printed. It joins manus 'hand' with scriptum 'written'.
entries.definitionCN: 手写而非印刷的文本。它由 manus“手”+ scriptum“写”构成。

entries.definition: by hand, by means of the hand. It is the adverb from manual, recorded in the late 15c.
entries.definitionCN: 用手地；靠手完成地。它是 manual 的副词，记录于 15 世纪晚期。

entries.definition: a concise reference book. It is the closest synonym of manual in the book sense, and itself translates Latin manualis.
entries.definitionCN: 简明参考书。它是 manual 在“书”这一义项上最接近的同义词，本身正是对拉丁语 manualis 的翻译。

entries.definition: a book or person that shows the way. It is broader than manual: a guide may describe a city, while a manual explains how to operate something.
entries.definitionCN: 指路的书或人。它比 manual 更宽：guide 可以介绍一座城市，而 manual 说明如何操作某物。

entries.definition: worked by hand rather than automatically. It overlaps manual in the device sense but cannot mean a handbook.
entries.definitionCN: 用手而非自动操作的。它在装置义上与 manual 重叠，但不能表示手册。

entries.definition: relating to the body rather than the mind. Manual work is always physical, but physical work need not use the hands.
entries.definitionCN: 与身体而非心智有关。manual 工作一定是体力/身体的，但体力工作不一定用手。

normalIntro.en: Real parts and real relatives: manus 'hand' is the whole story, and it also appears in manuscript, manufacture, manicure, manacle and manage.
normalIntro.cn: 真实构词与真实同族词：manus“手”就是全部故事，它也出现在 manuscript、manufacture、manicure、manacle、manage 里。

normal.en: manualis is 'of the hand'. Manual labour is work of the hand; a manual is a book small enough for the hand; a manual gearbox is shifted by hand.
normal.cn: manualis 就是“属于手的”。manual labour 是手的劳动；manual 是一本一手可拿的书；manual gearbox 是用手换挡的变速箱。

normal.en: Hand and book meet in the noun: the etymological sense of manual is 'a small book such as may be carried in the hand'.
normal.cn: 手与书在名词义里相遇：manual 的词源义就是“一本可以拿在手里携带的小书”。

normal.en: Manual exercise (1760) is a fixed sequence of hand movements with a rifle, so manual can name a drill as well as a book.
normal.cn: manual exercise（1760）是一套用步枪完成的固定手部动作，所以 manual 也能指操典，而不只是书。

normal.en: Manual override exists so a person can take control back from an automatic system: manual means 'the human hand is still allowed in'.
normal.cn: manual override 的存在，是为了让人能从自动系统手里夺回控制权：manual 意味着“人的手仍然被允许介入”。

normal.en: Manuscript, manufacture and manicure all use manus: writing by hand, making by hand, caring for the hand.
normal.cn: manuscript、manufacture、manicure 都用 manus：手写、手做、照料手。

abstract.en: Picture a hand and a thin book: the hand can work without the book, and the book can be held by the hand. Manual lives where the two meet.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手和一本薄书：手可以不用书就工作，书可以被手拿着。manual 就活在这两者相遇的地方。

abstract.en: The same word covers the tool (hand), the mode (manual operation), the guide (handbook) and the object (a manual car). The hand is the hinge.
abstract.cn: 同一个词覆盖工具（手）、方式（手动操作）、指南（手册）和物件（手动挡车）。手就是那个铰链。

abstract.en: When a machine automates the hand, manual becomes the exception that lets the hand return — a switch, a lever, an override.
abstract.cn: 当机器替代了手，manual 就成了让手回来的例外——一个开关、一根拉杆、一次超控。

examples.en: The manual explains how to reset the device in four steps.
examples.cn: 这本手册用四个步骤说明如何重置设备。

examples.en: Manual work is cheaper here, but slower than the new machine.
examples.cn: 这里的手工劳动更便宜，但比新机器慢。

examples.en: He prefers a manual because he likes choosing the gear.
examples.cn: 他更喜欢手动挡，因为他喜欢自己选挡位。

dict_mnemonic.text: “曼牛”——慢悠悠的牛拉着手工犁，旁边放着一本操作手册 → manual 手工的、手册

root: 拉丁语 manualis“属于手的”，来自 manus“手”，核心是“用手完成、用手操作”，并引申为“一手可持的小书”。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses of manual, all centred on the hand: work done by hand, a hand control, physical labour, a handbook held in one hand, a manual car, an organ keyboard, a rifle drill, and the boundary against menial.
sensesIntro.cn: manual 的八个义项都围绕手：用手完成的工作、手动控制、体力劳动、一手可持的手册、手动挡汽车、管风琴手键盘、步枪操典，以及它与 menial 的边界。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a hand does the work, and a thin book fits into that same hand.
core.cn: 核心意象：手完成工作，而一本薄书正好放进同一只手里。

branches.en: METHOD: work is done by hand rather than by machine.
branches.cn: 方式：工作靠手完成，而不是靠机器。

branches.en: CONTROL: a switch, a gear lever, an organ keyboard and a rifle drill all place the hand on a control.
branches.cn: 控制：开关、换挡杆、管风琴键盘与步枪操典，都把放在控制件上的手作为核心。

branches.en: LABOUR: handwork becomes a social category opposed to mental or office work.
branches.cn: 劳动：手工成为与脑力或办公室工作相对的社会类别。

branches.en: BOOK: a handbook is defined by being small enough to hold and use in one hand.
branches.cn: 书：手册之所以是手册，在于它小到可以一手拿着使用。

branches.en: BOUNDARY: manual names the instrument, not the status, so it never becomes menial by itself.
branches.cn: 边界：manual 命名工具，不命名地位，因此它本身从不等于 menial。

intro.en: Manual has no live English prefix. Its Latin stem manualis is frozen inside; English adds -ly, -ism and -ist, and forms compounds such as manual transmission and manual override.
intro.cn: manual 没有活的英语前缀。它的拉丁词干 manualis 凝固在词内；英语加 -ly、-ism、-ist，并构成 manual transmission、manual override 这类复合词。

latinIntro.en: The Latin family is built on manus 'hand': manuscript is hand-written, manufacture is hand-made, manicure is hand-care, and manacle is a hand-ring.
latinIntro.cn: 这一拉丁词族建立在 manus“手”上：manuscript 是手写，manufacture 是手做，manicure 是照料手，manacle 是套手的环。

items.meaning: by hand, by means of the hand
items.meaningCN: 用手地；手动地（-ly 构成副词）
items.example: The valve must be closed manually.
items.exampleCN: 这个阀门必须手动关闭。

items.meaning: the practice or doctrine of teaching deaf people by hand signs, or of emphasizing manual training
items.meaningCN: 手语教学法；强调手工训练的主张（-ism 构成做法或主义）
items.example: Manualism competed with oralism in deaf education.
items.exampleCN: 在聋人教育中，手语教学法曾与口语教学法竞争。

items.meaning: a supporter of manual training or of hand-sign teaching
items.meaningCN: 主张手工训练者；手语教学者（-ist 表示实践者或支持者）
items.example: The manualists argued for keeping sign language in class.
items.exampleCN: 手语教学派主张在课堂上保留手语。

items.meaning: standardized according to a written manual, especially in therapy or research
items.meaningCN: 按书面手册标准化的（-ize 表示“使……化”，-ed 构成形容词）
items.example: The treatment was manualized so that every clinic followed the same steps.
items.exampleCN: 这种治疗被手册化了，好让每家诊所都按同样步骤执行。

items.example: The hand is the base of manual and manuscript.
items.exampleCN: “手”是 manual 与 manuscript 的基础。

items.example: The form appears in manumit and manufacture.
items.exampleCN: 这个形式见于 manumit 与 manufacture。

items.example: It makes the adjective manual from the hand noun.
items.exampleCN: 它由“手”构成形容词 manual。

items.example: The same hand root built manipulate.
items.exampleCN: 同一个“手”词根也构成了 manipulate。

latinEntries.meaning: to make goods, originally by hand
care for the hands and nails
a ring for the hand; a handcuff

definition_zh: 制造；生产；捏造；制成品；制造业
definition_en: to make goods from materials, usually in quantity, and also to invent an excuse or a story
core_image: 老厂里，工人把熔化的金属倒进模具，冷却后取出齿轮毛坯
scene: 老厂里，工人把熔化的金属倒进模具，冷却后取出齿轮毛坯。They manufacture the gears from scrap steel rather than from new billets.
sceneCN: 句中的说法指「用原料加工出成品」（第 1 个义项：把材料制成物件）；句意为他们用废钢而不是新钢坯来制造这些齿轮。图中可辨识物件：熔炉、模具、齿轮毛坯、冷却水槽；对应第 1 个义项。

pos.zh: 制造；生产
捏造；编造
制成品（常用复数）
制造业；制造

senses.title: Make goods from materials
senses.definition: to work raw materials or parts into finished objects
senses.definitionCN: 把原料或零件加工成成品
senses.example: They manufacture the gears from scrap steel rather than from new billets.
senses.exampleCN: 他们用废钢而不是新钢坯来制造这些齿轮。
senses.why: The Latin phrase behind the word means made by hand, so the verb begins as making an object out of material.
senses.whyCN: 这个词背后的拉丁短语意为「用手做成」，因此动词最初就是把材料做成物件。

senses.title: Produce in quantity
senses.definition: to make goods in large numbers by an organised process
senses.definitionCN: 通过有组织的流程大量制造商品
senses.example: The plant manufactures a million bottles a month.
senses.exampleCN: 这家工厂每月生产一百万只瓶子。
senses.why: Once making is organised in a factory, quantity becomes the point, and the verb carries that scale.
senses.whyCN: 一旦制作在工厂里被组织起来，数量就成了要点，动词也就带上了这种规模。

senses.title: Assemble components into a whole
senses.definition: to put together bought-in parts into a finished unit
senses.definitionCN: 把外购零件组成一台完整设备
senses.example: The workshop manufactures frames and buys the rest.
senses.exampleCN: 这个车间自制车架，其余部件外购。
senses.why: Making a whole from parts is still making, even when most parts arrive finished.
senses.whyCN: 用零件做成整体仍算制作，即使大多数零件送来时已是成品。

senses.title: Produce a substance in the body
senses.definition: to generate a substance naturally, as an organ or a cell does
senses.definitionCN: 如器官或细胞那样自然生成某种物质
senses.example: The liver manufactures bile and releases it into the gut.
senses.exampleCN: 肝脏合成胆汁并把它释放到肠道。
senses.why: A living organ makes a substance the way a workshop makes a product, so biology borrowed the verb.
senses.whyCN: 活体器官制造一种物质，正如作坊制造产品，因此生物学借用了这个动词。

senses.title: Invent an excuse or evidence
senses.definition: to create something false and present it as if it were true
senses.definitionCN: 编造不实之物并当作真的呈现
senses.example: He manufactured an alibi before the interview.
senses.exampleCN: 他在面谈之前编造了一个不在场证明。
senses.why: The sense grows from the same idea: something is made out of nothing and put forward as real.
senses.whyCN: 这层意思出自同一观念：某物从无中被做出来，并被当作真的拿出来。

senses.title: Goods, in the plural
senses.definition: products of industry, as opposed to raw materials
senses.definitionCN: 工业产品，与原材料相对
senses.example: The country exports manufactures rather than raw ore.
senses.exampleCN: 这个国家出口制成品而不是原矿。
senses.why: The verb's product becomes a noun, and economists use the plural for made goods as a class.
senses.whyCN: 动词的产物变成名词，经济学家用复数形式指作为一大类的制成品。

senses.title: The industry, as a noun
senses.definition: the activity or trade of making goods, taken as a whole
senses.definitionCN: 制造商品的活动或行业整体
senses.example: Manufacture of cloth once paid half the town's wages.
senses.exampleCN: 布匹制造曾支付了全镇一半的工资。
senses.why: The uncountable noun names the activity itself, which is how the word stands for an industry.
senses.whyCN: 不可数名词指活动本身，这个词由此代表一个行业。

senses.title: Churn out something worthless
senses.definition: to produce something quickly and in volume with little care
senses.definitionCN: 以很小的用心快速大量产出
senses.example: The studio manufactures hit songs on a yearly schedule.
senses.exampleCN: 这家工作室按年度排程批量炮制热门歌曲。
senses.why: When quantity is all that matters, the same verb turns critical: making becomes mere turning out.
senses.whyCN: 当数量成为唯一要紧的事，同一个动词就带上批评意味：制作沦为「出货」。

intro.en: Manufacture came through French from the Latin phrase for made by hand, and its senses spread from handwork to factory goods to invented stories. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: 这个词经法语来自拉丁语「用手做成」的短语，词义从手工制品扩到工厂商品，再扩到编造的故事。年代均为约数。

items.en: Manus meant 'hand'; its deeper root is reconstructed, so source uncertain below Latin.
items.cn: manus 意为「手」；其更深词根属重构形式，故拉丁语以下来源不确定。

items.en: Facere meant 'to make, to do'; its pre-Latin root is also reconstructed.
items.cn: facere 意为「做、制作」；其在拉丁语之前的词根也属重构形式。

items.en: The phrase meant 'made by hand', describing work of skill as opposed to what grows by itself.
items.cn: 这个短语意为「用手做成」，指凭技艺完成的工作，与自然生长之物相对。

items.en: French manufacture carried it into English in the seventeenth century for things made by hand and for the making of them.
items.cn: 法语 manufacture 在十七世纪把它带入英语，指手工制品及其制作。

items.en: In the nineteenth century the verb moved to factory production; the sense of inventing something false is older and rests on the same image of making.
items.cn: 到十九世纪，动词转向工厂生产；编造不实之物的意思更早，且基于同一「做出来」的意象。

note.en: Group one holds words of the same family in other grammatical roles; group two holds verbs for making or inventing something.
note.cn: 第一组是同族词的其他词类形式；第二组是表示「制作」或「编造」的动词。

entries.definition: The agent noun for the company that carries out the making.
entries.definitionCN: 施动名词，指执行制造的企业。

entries.definition: The process or the industry, with no object and no doer named.
entries.definitionCN: 指过程或行业，不点明对象与施动者。

entries.definition: A building where goods are made; it comes from the same Latin verb of making, through a different noun.
entries.definitionCN: 制造商品的建筑，同出拉丁「制作」动词，但走的是另一条名词路径。

entries.definition: From faber 'smith, craftsman', not from facere: it means putting parts together, or a lie.
entries.definitionCN: 出自 faber「工匠」，而非 facere：指把部件组装起来，也指谎言。

entries.definition: The everyday verb for producing anything, with no hint of factories or quantity.
entries.definitionCN: 泛指做出任何东西的日常动词，不含工厂或数量的意味。

entries.definition: To bring forth goods, crops or results; it covers farming and energy as well.
entries.definitionCN: 产出商品、农产品或结果，也涵盖农业与能源。

entries.definition: To build a structure from parts, or to invent a story; it shares the second sense of the entry but not its first.
entries.definitionCN: 用部件搭建结构，或编造故事；与本词共用第二个义项，但不用第一个。

entries.definition: To fit components together, which is one stage inside manufacturing.
entries.definitionCN: 把零件接合起来，是制造内部的一个阶段。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real collocations and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实搭配与真实同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: 'Hand' plus 'make': the Latin phrase meant made by hand, and the verb kept the idea of turning material into an object.
normal.cn: 「手」加「做」：拉丁短语意为用手做成，动词保留了把材料变成物件的意思。

normal.en: The family runs manufacturer, manufacturing, manufactured and the adjective for what can be made.
normal.cn: 同族词包括制造商、制造业、制成的，以及表示可制造的形容词。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark both sides: manufacture goods, manufacture parts, manufacture an excuse.
normal.cn: 固定说法标出两面：制造商品、生产零件、编造借口。

normal.en: Making a true thing and making a false one are the same act with different material.
normal.cn: 造真东西与造假东西，是同一个动作换了材料。

normal.en: In economics the plural means made goods, and the uncountable form means the industry.
normal.cn: 在经济学里，复数指制成品，不可数形式指制造业。

abstract.en: Picture molten metal settling into the shape of a gear.
abstract.cn: 想象熔化的金属沉入齿轮的形状。

abstract.en: Picture a story assembled from spare parts, then told as fact.
abstract.cn: 想象一个用零碎部件拼成的故事，随后被当作事实讲出。

abstract.en: Picture a conveyor that never stops, and a shelf nobody inspects.
abstract.cn: 想象一条从不停下的传送带，和一个无人检查的货架。

examples.en: The firm manufactures its own sensors rather than buying them.
examples.cn: 这家公司自己制造传感器，而不是外购。

examples.en: A country that manufactures little imports almost everything.
examples.cn: 制造业薄弱的国家几乎什么都要进口。

examples.en: He manufactured a reason for leaving that nobody believed.
examples.cn: 他编了一个没人相信的离开理由。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「manu（手）+ fact（做）+ ure」——用手做出来的 → 制造；转而指「做出来的话」→ 捏造

root: 拉丁语中表示「手」的名词与表示「做」的动词构成「用手做成」的短语，经法语成为一词；两个词根更早的来源均属重构形式。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one making: material becomes an object, quantity becomes the aim, parts become a unit, a body makes a substance, a lie is made, the products become a noun, the activity becomes an industry, and finally speed replaces care.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项沿同一次「做」展开：材料变成物件、数量成为目标、零件成为整机、身体合成物质、谎言被做出来、产品变成名词、活动变成行业，最后速度取代了用心。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: molten metal poured into a mould and lifted out as a gear blank.
core.cn: 核心意象：熔化的金属被倒进模具，取出时已是齿轮毛坯。

branches.en: ONE OBJECT AND MANY: a single gear and a million bottles are the same making at two scales.
branches.cn: 一个与许多：一枚齿轮与一百万只瓶子，是同一种制作的两个规模。

branches.en: BUILDING A UNIT: fitting parts into a machine and an organ making a substance both assemble a whole.
branches.cn: 组成整体：把零件装成机器与器官合成物质，都在组成一个整体。

branches.en: MAKING WITHOUT MATERIAL: a false alibi and a churned-out song are made with words and speed rather than substance.
branches.cn: 不以材料制作：假的不在场证明与批量炮制的歌，用言辞与速度而非材料做成。

branches.en: THE PRODUCT AS A NOUN: made goods become a class in trade statistics.
branches.cn: 产物成为名词：制成品在贸易统计中成为一大类。

branches.en: THE ACTIVITY AS AN INDUSTRY: the uncountable name stands for a whole trade.
branches.cn: 活动成为行业：不可数名称代表整个行业。

intro.en: Manufacture is a Latin phrase compressed into one French word: a noun for hand, a verb for making, and the ending that carries it into English.
intro.cn: 这是一个被压缩成一个法语词的拉丁短语：一个表示「手」的名词、一个表示「做」的动词，以及把它带进英语的词尾。

latinIntro.en: Latin manus gives manual, manage and manuscript; facere gives factory, fact and fabrication; together they name work made by hand.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语表示「手」的词衍生出手动的、经营与手稿等词；表示「做」的动词衍生出工厂、事实与制作等词；两者合起来指用手做成的工作。

items.example: The hand is the instrument in the phrase.
items.exampleCN: 在这个短语里，手是工具。

items.structure: facere, feci, factum (Latin verb, third conjugation)
items.example: The verb carries the action of making.
items.exampleCN: 这个动词承载「制作」的动作。

items.example: The phrase is the source of the whole word.
items.exampleCN: 这个短语是整词的来源。

items.example: French fused the phrase into a single noun and verb.
items.exampleCN: 法语把这个短语合成一个名词兼动词。

items.example: The ending marks the outcome of the making.
items.exampleCN: 这个词尾标记制作的结果。

items.example: The agent suffix names the firm.
items.exampleCN: 施动后缀指企业。

items.example: The process suffix removes the doer.
items.exampleCN: 过程后缀去掉了施动者。

items.example: The participle carries both the factory sense and the false one.
items.exampleCN: 这个分词兼带工厂义与虚假义。

definition_zh: 制造商；生产商；厂商
definition_en: a company or person that makes goods from raw materials, especially in large quantities
core_image: 展会现场，一家工厂的展台上摆着自家生产的电机，名片上只印着工厂的名字
scene: 展会现场，一家工厂的展台上摆着自家生产的电机，名片上只印着工厂名。The manufacturer recalled twelve thousand units after a fault appeared in the field.
sceneCN: 句中的说法指「生产这些商品的工厂或公司」（第 1 个义项：以原料批量生产商品的企业）；句意为现场出现故障后，制造商召回了十二万台产品。图中可辨识物件：展台、电机、名片、召回通知单；对应第 1 个义项。

pos.zh: 制造商；生产商（可数）
厂商；品牌所有者（相对零售商）

senses.title: A firm that makes goods
senses.titleCN: 制造商品的工厂或公司
senses.definition: a business that turns raw materials or parts into finished products
senses.definitionCN: 把原料或零件变成成品的企业
senses.example: The manufacturer recalled twelve thousand units after a fault appeared in the field.
senses.exampleCN: 现场出现故障后，制造商召回了十二万台产品。
senses.why: The agent suffix marks the doer of the verb, so the maker of goods is simply the one who manufactures.
senses.whyCN: 施动后缀标记动作的执行者，因此生产商品者就是执行「制造」的那一方。

senses.title: The brand owner, as against the shop
senses.titleCN: 与零售商相对的品牌厂商
senses.definition: the party responsible for the product's design and warranty, in contrast to the retailer
senses.definitionCN: 对产品设计与保修负责、与零售商相对的一方
senses.example: Retailers pass warranty claims back to the manufacturer.
senses.exampleCN: 零售商把保修索赔转回给厂商。
senses.why: Liability and warranty follow the maker rather than the seller, which fixes this legal-commercial sense.
senses.whyCN: 责任与保修跟着生产者而不是销售者，这固定了这层法律与商业含义。

senses.title: A maker of machinery
senses.definition: a firm that builds machines or equipment for other businesses
senses.definitionCN: 为其他企业建造机器或设备的企业
senses.example: The press manufacturer sends an engineer for every installation.
senses.exampleCN: 压机制造商每次安装都会派一名工程师。
senses.why: Industrial buyers speak of the firm that built the machine as its manufacturer, even when it makes nothing else.
senses.whyCN: 工业买家把造这台机器的企业称为它的制造商，即使它不做别的产品。

senses.title: A car maker
senses.definition: a company that assembles vehicles and sells them under its own name
senses.definitionCN: 组装车辆并以自己名义出售的公司
senses.example: Three car manufacturers share one battery plant.
senses.exampleCN: 三家汽车制造商共用一座电池工厂。
senses.why: In vehicles the assembler is treated as the maker even though most parts come from elsewhere.
senses.whyCN: 在汽车业，即使大部分零件来自别处，组装者仍被视为制造者。

senses.title: A drug maker
senses.definition: a company that produces medicines and holds the licence for them
senses.definitionCN: 生产药品并持有相关许可的公司
senses.example: The drug manufacturer filed for approval in two markets.
senses.exampleCN: 这家药品生产商在两个市场申请了批准。
senses.why: Regulated products need a named responsible firm, and that firm is called the manufacturer in law.
senses.whyCN: 受管制产品需要一个具名的责任企业，法律上这家企业就称为制造商。

senses.title: A contract maker for another brand
senses.titleCN: 为他人品牌代工的生产商
senses.definition: a firm that builds goods to another company's specification and brand
senses.definitionCN: 按另一家公司的规格与品牌生产商品的企业
senses.example: As an original equipment manufacturer, it builds parts to a client's drawing.
senses.exampleCN: 作为原始设备制造商，它按客户的图纸生产零件。
senses.why: When design and brand belong to one firm and production to another, the producer is still the manufacturer of record.
senses.whyCN: 当设计与品牌属一家、生产属另一家时，生产方仍是名义上的制造商。

senses.title: An employer in wage talks
senses.titleCN: 劳资语境中的制造企业
senses.definition: factory owners taken together as the employing side in negotiations
senses.definitionCN: 在谈判中被当作雇主一方的工厂所有者整体
senses.example: The manufacturers and the union reached a wage deal.
senses.exampleCN: 制造企业与工会达成了工资协议。
senses.why: In labour disputes a whole group of firms is addressed as one party, and the trade name stands for the employers.
senses.whyCN: 在劳资争议中，一群企业被当作一方来对话，行业称呼便代表雇主。

senses.title: The responsible party in product law
senses.definition: the party legally answerable for a defect in a product, whatever the chain of sale
senses.definitionCN: 不论销售链条如何，对产品缺陷负法律责任的一方
senses.example: Liability falls on the manufacturer, not the shop.
senses.exampleCN: 责任落在制造商身上，而不是店铺。
senses.why: Product liability law needs one identifiable party at the origin, and that party is the manufacturer.
senses.whyCN: 产品责任法需要在源头有一个可辨认的责任方，这个责任方就是制造商。

intro.en: Manufacturer is the maker-noun of a French-derived verb, with an English agent suffix added. The Latin base means 'made by hand'. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: 这是一个法语来源动词的施动名词，加上了英语表示「做者」的后缀。其拉丁底子意为「用手做成」。年代均为约数。

items.en: Manus 'hand' supplies the first half; its deeper root is reconstructed, so source uncertain below Latin.
items.cn: manus「手」提供前半；其更深词根属重构形式，故拉丁语以下来源不确定。

items.en: Facere 'to make' supplies the second half, and its pre-Latin root is also reconstructed.
items.cn: facere「制作」提供后半，其在拉丁语之前的词根同样属重构形式。
